title: 2003 AMC 10B Problem 23
statement: A regular octagon \(ABCDEFGH\) has an area of one square unit. What is the area of the rectangle \(ABEF?\)

solutions.text:
Let \(O\) be the center. The octagon splits into \(8\) congruent triangles from \(O,\) so \(\triangle AOB\) has area \(\dfrac18.\)

Since \(O\) is the midpoint of \(AE,\) triangles \(AOB\) and \(BOE\) have equal area, so \(\triangle ABE\) has area \(\dfrac14.\) The rectangle \(ABEF\) is twice this, namely \(\dfrac12.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: Let \(O\) be the center of the octagon, where the diagonals of \(ABEF\) meet
Triangle \(AOB\) is one of the eight congruent triangles making up the octagon
